text:
deploy-bot: config-only deploy queued for PROD in the evening change window (23:00-00:00 UTC). Targets: routing policy + batching params + per-route timeouts. Canary set: 5% traffic to region 'eu-west-1-canary'.

alex: acknowledged. I can own the canary watch. planning a 15m hold after canary then 30m gradual ramp.

maria: config diff attached inline. main tweaks: `max_inflight=120 -> 80` (to reduce head-of-line), `batch_window_ms=20 -> 12`, `request_timeout_ms=30000 -> 25000` for high-qos routes. Also add `rate_floor=5rps` for internal control-plane calls.

jamal: any model pinning needed? this is purely config, no model changes from my side. I'd avoid pinning unless rollout affects model selection.

sophie: please add `warmup_nodes=2` and `kv_cache_prefetch=true` to the canary profile — we've seen cold-start blips otherwise.

priya: observability checklist:
- smoke evals (latency P50/P95) for top 10 routes
- per-route error-rate and 5xx counts
- token-cost delta and throttles
- tracing hooks for route-fallbacks
I'll push dashboards and a quick alert runbook.

zach: propose an automatic rollback trigger: if canary 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR P95 latency increases by >30% for 10m then revert to previous config. Also add an SEV ping to #oncall if triggered.

oncall-bot: noted. Alerting patrol rule created: `canary-config-watch-v2`. Alerts to #eng-oncall and SMS after 2 consecutive fires.

alex: deploy steps I'm going to run:```
# staging check
rdeploy validate --env prod --config routing-v2 --dry-run
# apply canary
rdeploy apply --env prod --config routing-v2 --subset eu-west-1-canary --meta "config-only"
```

maria: ship the release-note blurb: "Config-only: routing/batching/timeouts. Canary 5% eu-west-1-canary, auto-rollback thresholds set. No model changes." Will attach to release notes.

jamal: quick question — should we pin the routing variant for Dedicated customers? might avoid surprise.

sophie: yes, add opt-in pin via tenant config for Dedicated; default remains unpinned.

priya: post-deploy checks I want run automatically: `smoke-eval`, `trace-sanity`, `kvcache-hitrate`. If any fail mark deploy as failed.

zach: if rollback happens, ensure we also revert `warmup_nodes` because it can cause scheduling churn.

deploy-bot: canary apply started at 23:00:10 UTC. Monitoring hooks engaged.

oncall-bot: 23:06:25 UTC — metric: canary P95 latency +35% vs baseline for route /chat/generate (5m window).

alex: seeing the spike in traces too, rolling back canary. Executing revert now.

deploy-bot: revert completed at 23:07:12 UTC. Canary traffic drained.

maria: postmortem note: warmup_nodes likely introduced scheduling bump for eu-west; we'll tweak warmup strategy and re-run in a later quiet window.

priya: follow-up tasks created:
- reduce warmup to 1 and re-evaluate
- add synthetic load test for canary profile
- update runbook with exact rollback command and owners

zach: closing loop: leave auto-rollback thresholds as-is, tweak warmup. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
